title: 第二百八十七章 生死一瞬第二百八十六章 孤胆英雄
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
张三与朱华音的接力逃亡已持续了十余里。
两人如同在刀尖上跳舞，每一次交接都险象环生。张三时而以子母追魂胆在兽潮侧翼炸开毒雾钢针，扰乱阵型；时而发动川海归元遁入地下，拉开距离后重新现身播放录音仪。
朱华音则在她负责的接力点上精准吹奏《狂兽引》，她本人吹奏的效果依然比张三的录音仪要好很多，不仅范围更广还能将暴怒的蜘蛛群牢牢吸引，但她的机动性和自保能力显然差很多，能坚持的时间和距离只有张三的一半。
不过好在张三扛住了压力，总能在朱华音坚持不住的时候及时发出动响，转移兽潮的仇恨。
然而，这种诱引战术终究有其极限。
当两人在第十二个接力点汇合，准备继续向西牵引时，异变突生。
“嘶——！！！”
血瞳鬼蛛王那八只燃烧着血红火焰的复眼死死盯着两人所在的山坡，同时发出一声充满暴躁与不耐的嘶鸣。
然而看着要发飙，它那庞大的身躯却停在原地不再追击，反而缓缓转向东方，那是蛛网镇的方向。
周围的精英蜘蛛群也随之停下，复眼中凶光闪烁，似乎在权衡王的命令。
“不好！”张三脸色一变，“它要放弃追击，重新进攻蛛网镇！”
朱华音放下长笛，脸色苍白：“连续被同样的方法戏耍十余里，这八万年的兽王即便再蠢，也已经意识到我们是在刻意引它远离蛛网镇。兽潮的本能是觅食与扩张，蛛网镇近在眼前，那里有无数‘养分’，它不可能继续被我们牵着鼻子走。”
“那怎么办？”张三急道，“我们只剩不到十里就能抵达武魂殿大军驻扎的区域了！功亏一篑吗？”
朱华音沉默片刻，眼中闪过决然：“只有一个办法了。”
“什么办法？”
“现身，强攻。”朱华音一字一句道，“我们不能再躲在暗处用音律牵引。必须主动出击，直接进攻兽潮，最好是能伤到血瞳鬼蛛王或者它身边的精英，彻底激怒它，让它将我们视为必须优先清除的威胁。然后，我们且战且退，用实战牵引它们走完最后十里。”
张三倒吸一口凉气：“主动进攻？前辈，您现在的状态……”
“顾不了那么多了。”朱华音打断他，声音冷冽如冰，“事不宜迟，动手！”
话音未落，朱华音已纵身跃下山坡，白银玄凤笛横在唇边，身后第二魂环亮起——
“第二魂技·随心而鸣！”

尖锐刺耳的笛声化作无数无形音刃，如同暴雨般射入兽潮边缘的低级蜘蛛群中！
噗噗噗噗——！
音刃所过之处，数十只十年、百年蜘蛛瞬间被切割成碎片，绿色的体液混杂着甲壳残骸四溅！
几乎同时，张三也从另一侧杀入。他双手化作龙爪，鬼影迷踪步在蜘蛛群中穿梭，专挑那些体型较小、防御较弱的蜘蛛下手，每一击都直取复眼或关节，迅速清理出一片真空区域。
两人的突然强攻，果然引起了血瞳鬼蛛王的注意。
它八只血瞳猛地转向两人，口中发出震耳欲聋的咆哮！那声音中蕴含着被蝼蚁挑衅的滔天怒意！
这一次，它是真的被彻底激怒了。
区区两个人类，不仅屡次戏耍于它，竟还敢主动攻击它的子民！
必须碾碎他们！将他们撕成碎片！吞噬他们的血肉魂力！
“吼——！！！”
血瞳鬼蛛王八条长腿狠狠插入地面，庞大的身躯如同战车般朝着两人冲来！它所过之处，大地龟裂，泥土翻飞，低级蜘蛛纷纷退避。
整个兽潮，在王的意志下，再次调转方向，如同黑色的死亡洪流，朝着张三与朱华音汹涌扑来！
“撤！”朱华音厉喝一声，与张三同时转身，朝着西边全力奔逃。
这一次，不再是音律牵引，而是实战逃亡。
两人一边跑，一边还要应对身后不断袭来的蛛丝、毒液、乃至血瞳鬼蛛王那恐怖的精神冲击。
张三时不时回身掷出子母追魂胆，炸开一片毒雾阻碍追兵；朱华音则吹奏镇魂音，试图迟滞精英蜘蛛的速度。
content_en:
The relay escape between Zhang San and Zhu Huayin lasted for more than ten miles.
The two of them were dancing on the tip of a knife, and every handover was fraught with danger. Sometimes Zhang San uses his son-mother soul-chasing courage to explode poisonous mist steel needles on the flanks of the beast tide, disrupting the formation; sometimes he activates Sichuan Hai Guiyuan to escape underground, distances himself and then reappears to play the recorder.
Zhu Huayin played "Wild Beasts" accurately at the relay point she was responsible for. The effect of her own playing was still much better than Zhang San's recorder. Not only did she have a wider range, but she could also firmly attract the angry spiders. However, her mobility and self-protection ability were obviously much worse, and the time and distance she could last were only half of Zhang San's.
Fortunately, Zhang San withstood the pressure and was always able to make a sound in time when Zhu Huayin couldn't hold on anymore to divert the hatred of the beast tide.
However, this seduction tactic has its limits.
When the two men met at the twelfth relay point and prepared to continue pulling westward, a sudden change occurred.
"Hiss-!!!"
The eight compound eyes burning with blood-red flames of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King stared intently at the hillside where the two of them were, and at the same time let out a neighing sound full of irritability and impatience.
However, it looked like it was about to go berserk, but its huge body stopped in place and stopped pursuing it. Instead, it slowly turned to the east, which was the direction of Spider Web Town.
The surrounding elite spiders also stopped, their compound eyes flashing fiercely, as if they were weighing the king's order.
"Not good!" Zhang San's expression changed, "It's going to give up the pursuit and attack Spider Web Town again!"
Zhu Huayin put down his flute and looked pale: "Being teased in the same way for more than ten miles, the 80,000-year-old beast king, no matter how stupid it is, has realized that we are deliberately leading it away from Spider Web Town. The instinct of the beast tide is to forage and expand. Spider Web Town is right in front of us, and there are countless 'nutrients' there. It cannot continue to be led by us."
"Then what should we do?" Zhang San asked anxiously, "We only have less than ten miles left to reach the area where the Wuhun Palace army is stationed! Did we fall short?"
Zhu Huayin was silent for a moment, determination flashed in his eyes: "There is only one way."
"What can I do?"
"Show up and attack forcefully." Zhu Huayin said word by word, "We can no longer hide in the dark and use music to lead us. We must take the initiative and directly attack the beast tide. It is best to hurt the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King or the elites around it, completely angering it and making it regard us as a threat that must be eliminated first. Then, we will fight and retreat, and use actual combat to lead them through the last ten miles."
Zhang San took a breath: "Active attack? Senior, your current state..."
"I can't care about that much anymore." Zhu Huayin interrupted him, his voice as cold as ice, "Without further delay, let's do it!"
Before he finished speaking, Zhu Huayin jumped down the hillside, holding the silver black phoenix flute to his lips, and the second soul ring behind him lit up——
"Second Soul Skill·Cry at your heart's content!"
The sharp and piercing sound of the flute turned into countless invisible sound blades, shooting like a heavy rain into the low-level spiders on the edge of the beast tide!
Puff puff puff puff——!
Wherever the sound blade passed, dozens of ten-year-old and century-old spiders were instantly cut into pieces, with green body fluids mixed with carapace debris splashing everywhere!
Almost at the same time, Zhang San also rushed in from the other side. His hands turned into dragon claws, and he moved ghostly through the spiders, specifically targeting spiders that were smaller in size and had weak defenses. Each attack would go straight to the compound eyes or joints, quickly clearing a vacuum area.
The sudden attack by the two men indeed attracted the attention of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King.
Its eight blood pupils suddenly turned towards the two of them, and it let out a deafening roar! That voice contained the overwhelming anger of being provoked by ants!
This time, it was really, really pissed off.
Two mere humans not only played tricks on it many times, but actually dared to attack its people!
They must be crushed! Tear them to pieces! Devour their flesh and soul!
"Roar——!!!"
The eight long legs of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King are thrust into the ground, and its huge body is likeRushing towards the two of them like a chariot! Wherever it passed, the ground cracked, soil flew, and low-level spiders retreated.
The entire beast tide, under the will of the king, changed direction again, like a black torrent of death, rushing towards Zhang San and Zhu Huayin!
"Retreat!" Zhu Huayin shouted sharply, turned around at the same time as Zhang San, and ran away with all their strength towards the west.
This time, it is no longer a musical pull, but an actual escape.
As the two ran, they had to deal with the spider silk, venom, and even the terrifying mental impact of the blood-eyed ghost spider king that was constantly coming from behind.
From time to time, Zhang San turned around and threw his son-in-law soul-chasing gallbladder, exploding a poisonous mist to hinder the pursuers; Zhu Huayin played the soul-soothing sound in an attempt to slow down the elite spider.
